It is certified to the bi-national ANSI Z21.88-2014 / CSA 2.33-2014 standard and has US-only manufactured-home wording, and no separate Canadian edition exists. The 141223 copy was found by site search.
availability_evidence: Live product page in the site's Products menu (Gas Products) and the homepage lineup; listed on the Manuals page. No US-sale restriction or availability notice on the page (read 2026-10-08).
